    AI Overview
    Yes, influencer Karely Ruiz announced she was pregnant in mid-2024 and welcomed her baby girl, Madisson, in early 2025, sharing moments of motherhood and her post-baby figure on social media, and introducing Gracie Bon as a co-parent in a playful manner. 
    Pregnancy & Birth Details:
    • Announcement:
      In August 2024, Ruiz announced her pregnancy, expressing immense joy, as seen in this Hindustan Times article. 
    • Gender Reveal:
      She later revealed she was expecting a baby girl, as reported by Hindustan Times. 
    • Birth:
      She welcomed her daughter, Madisson, in early 2025, as seen in this Exa Merida video. 
    Co-Parenting & Social Media: 
    • Ruiz shared her excitement about motherhood, posting about her postpartum body and introducing Panamanian influencer Gracie Bon as the "mother" of her daughter in a video, suggesting shared upbringing, according to Gale.
